OpenUI browser bundle dependency notices

The original OpenUI material is covered by vendor/openui/LICENSE. The upstream
browser bundle retains its embedded license comments. This file conservatively
collects the production dependency closure of OpenUI reference commit
9c5c43e78b95b69a2220c9f0d4bc4919d29067c9, including declarations which may have
been tree-shaken out of the published bundle. It is NOT an exact module-level
SBOM for the npm browser-bundle@0.1.7 build. Some peer type packages are also
listed by the reference dependency graph; their presence here does not claim
that TypeScript type declarations execute in the browser.

Licenses are copied from official npm archives, or supplemented from pinned
upstream licenses / declared standard license text where an archive omitted
its license file. See license-provenance.json for package versions, content
hashes, exact sources and supplement explanations. These third-party materials
remain under their original licenses, without Chaos's no-training restriction.
